paper_title: Can LLMs Solve longer Math Word Problems Better

model_annotation: The plot illustrates the performance of two methods—“w.o. extension” and “extension”—on a metric labeled “Missing Step” across five discrete steps (0 to 4) on the x-axis. The x-axis is linear, ranging from 0 to 4 with integer tick marks at each unit. The y-axis, labeled “Missing Step,” is also linear, ranging from 0.820 to 0.860 with tick marks at intervals of 0.010. The “w.o. extension” method is represented by a dashed blue line with circular markers, starting at approximately 0.835 at step 0 and decreasing to approximately 0.818 at step 4. The “extension” method is shown as a solid orange line with triangular markers, starting at approximately 0.860 at step 0 and decreasing to approximately 0.841 at step 4. Both lines show a consistent downward trend across the steps, with the “extension” method consistently yielding higher “Missing Step” values than the “w.o. extension” method at each step.
